title: Cursor pill button
description: Full-pill link buttons at weight 400: an ink pill that lightens a step on hover, a pale grey pill that darkens a step, and a hairline outline pill that fills with the panel colour. Colours change in 150ms on the standard ease.
notes: the ink pill's hover mixes the primary 12% toward the page colour, so it lightens on light themes and dims on dark ones
name: cursor-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label (an icon may follow it)

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: the ink pill · secondary: the pale grey pill · outline: a hairline pill (header)

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 28px, 14px text (header) · lg: 44px, 16px text (hero and closing call)
